statements.t: In North Carolina, we expect to commission our recent plant efficiency upgrades by year-end.
As utilization of this new capacity improves and progress on new products continues, we expect further growth and margin improvement in the coming quarters.
Fuel Specialties had another strong quarter delivering revenue growth and steady operating income with margins that remained within our target range.

While sequential results were lower than expected on continued activity delays in our legacy Middle East business and elevated raw material costs, we are expecting improvement across several of these areas to drive sequential operating income growth in the fourth quarter.”
